paragraphs.text: Felix Five-Boots is an ooze rogue who arrived on Thunder Junction after the opening of the Omenpaths .

Felix has specialized in one-on-one duels and is both difficult to hurt and menacing to face. This slimy scoundrel is infamous for having five pseudopods as feet and thus can keep standing steady even when facing down fierce competitors. Felix's lack of vital organs is also a big advantage.
